title: Guides contradict the spec-gap edits
description: Proposed edits for jmap-chat-spec-2dzn make three guides wrong: jmap-unified-client-architecture.md sections 4.x and 10.11 (~L628, ~L1564) promise a DID verified badge, now a MUST NOT in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00; jmap-vtc-chat-integration-guide.md L108 says clients MAY clear a stale activeCallId, now forbidden; jmap-chat-implementer-guide.md section 1.2 (last admin leaving a group) should cite the new removeMembers rules. Update the guides once Mark accepts the edits.
close_reason: Edits reviewed and decided by Mark 2026-10-18; committed in spec(chat) resolve gaps / mimi client surface.
